Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the daily handling rules for animals accepted through Aurelia Skyways and gives staff a common record of care, checks, and handoffs.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk serves animals with careful intake, clear records, and steady coordination with the senior coordinator. Staff should confirm the traveler, the carrier, and the service request before any animal is moved. The ground team must carry each crate or kennel without rough contact, keep pathways clear, and report any damage or distress at once. When a cat is accepted, <<FACT F067>> and the record must match the carrier label before release to the next station. A pet such as Teddy may be mentioned in notes only when needed for identification, and staff should keep all remarks factual and brief.

For bird travel, staff must check the species record, the travel readiness note, and the condition of the enclosure before acceptance. <<FACT F077>> The desk should keep the traveler informed of required handling steps and should not promise service until the file is complete. If a fee applies, <<FACT F059>> and the amount must be entered in the file exactly as shown by the current tariff. Staff must never guess at a charge, waive a rule without approval, or copy details from memory when the record is available.

Each handoff must be logged with the condition of the animal, the carrier, and the receiving station. Emil Hassan and Tomas Fischer may appear in records only as travelers when their files are active. The senior coordinator reviews exceptions, resolves unclear cases, and approves any unusual placement. If a question remains after the file review, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead for immediate direction.
